consumer: The dialogue/mission condition evaluator calling the u_has_item/npc_has_item conditional lambda, asking 'does the avatar (actor) possess item X on their person right now?'
scope: On-person possession of the character actor (held/wielded/worn/contained inventory via charges_of OR has_amount), not the wider reachable/map inventory
decisive_source: src/condition.cpp::conditional_t<T>::set_has_item — builds the condition lambda returning actor->charges_of(item_id) > 0 || actor->has_amount(item_id, 1) over d.alpha (or beta if npc), the exact engine-computed possession predicate a dialogue/mission check consumes
divergence: An item X lying on the ground on an adjacent reachable tile (or in a nearby container) but not on the avatar: a find-item/reachable-inventory objective would report present, but this u_has_item possession predicate correctly returns false — confirming the matched on-person scope
